annotation.title_clean: Resolución 161/2023 - Programa de transparencia y protección de datos personales en el uso de la Inteligencia Artificial
annotation.title_en: Resolution 161/2023 - Programme for transparency and personal data protection in the use of Artificial Intelligence
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (AAIP), Argentina
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine AAIP Resolution 161/2023 creates a Programme for transparency and personal data protection in the use of AI, citing OECD AI Principles and the UNESCO Recommendation. It tasks the transparency and data protection directorates with implementing, monitoring and evaluating the programme across public and private sectors. The annex is published separately.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates the Programme for transparency and personal data protection in the use of AI
Directs the National Directorates of Transparency Policy Evaluation and Personal Data Protection to implement it jointly
Grounded in OECD AI Principles, UNESCO Recommendation and Argentina's Trustworthy AI recommendations (Disposición 2/2023)
Covers AI use in both public and private sectors
